content.text: bisphos inhibit osteoclasts; USU the drugs of choice for cancer-associated hypercalcemia; repeated IV bisphos (bone mets, myeloma) are linked to ONJ; renal toxicity reported w zoledronic acid; PO bisphos can maintain norm Ca but aren't generally used acutely; calcitonin (salmon) 4 to 8 IU/kg SC every 12 h; can ↓Ca by 1 to 2 mg/dL w.in a few hrs; in cancer-associated hypercalcemia, limited by short action w tachyphylaxis (often after ~48 h) and ⍉response in ≥ 40%. salmon calcitonin + prednisone may control Ca for mo in some CA pts.

CI: hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon or any of the excipients (rxns incl anaphylaxis w/ death, bronchospasm, and swelling of the tongue or throat). Serious hypersensitivity rxns incl fatal anaphylaxis reported; consider skin testing b4 tx in pts w/ sus hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon. Hypocalcemia w/ tetany (musc cramps, twitching) and sz activity reported; hypocalcemia must be corrected b4 initiating therapy. Meta-analysis of 21 trials suggests an ↑ risk of overall malignancies in calcitonin salmon-treated pts. Circulating antibodies to calcitonin salmon may develop and may cause loss of response to tx. Concomitant lithium may ↓ plasma lithium concentrations (↑ urinary clearance); lithium dose may require adj. OD: hypocalcemic tetany could occur; keep parenteral calcium available for tx. MC adverse rxns: nausea w/ or w/o vomiting (10%), inj site inflam (10%), and flushing of the face or hands (2% to 5%). ←the poss assoc b/n malig and calcitonin salmon use, the need for continued therapy should be re-evaluated periodically.
